First public pre-release of the MMD Motion Importer: a Blockbench plugin that imports MikuMikuDance motion (`.vmd`) as GeckoLib animations on any model, plus a command-line tool that does the same conversions.

This is an alpha. It works on the models and dances it was tested with, but expect rough edges, and please report what breaks.

## Install

1. Download `mmd_motion_importer.js` below.
2. In Blockbench (4.8 or newer, desktop or web), open File > Plugins > Load Plugin from File and pick it.

To export for a mod you also need the GeckoLib Models & Animations plugin, as for any GeckoLib model.

## Try it

1. File > New > New Minecraft Dancer, and pick your Minecraft skin (optional).
2. File > Import > Import MMD Motion (.vmd), and pick a dance.
3. Press play in the Animate tab.

## What it does

- **Whole-body motion** from the dance, including knees bent by MMD's leg IK.
- **Hair, skirts and ties** swing by simulation and stay out of the head and body.
- **Blinks and mouth shapes** drive the model's face parts.
- **Keyframe reduction** keeps only the keys needed, for much smaller animations.
- **Performer groups:** one `.vmd` per performer, with matching lengths and stage positions.
- **Built-in dancer model** with the exact shape and skin layout of the Minecraft player (classic and slim arms), with optional hair, skirt and tie.
- **Tools for your own model** (Tools > MMD Motion Importer):
  - Prepare Model for Dancing fixes the rig in one undoable step.
  - Generate Bone Mapping works out which bone follows which part of the dance.
  - Edit Bone Mapping lets you adjust it; the mapping is saved inside the project.
  - Check Rig adds a test animation that moves one direction at a time.
  - Apply Minecraft Skin changes the dancer's skin.

## Command line

`miku-motion-cli.tgz` holds the same converter as a single file for Node 20 or newer:

```bash
tar -xzf miku-motion-cli.tgz
node miku-motion.mjs --help
```

## Known limits

- Camera, lights and MMD's own physics are not converted; sound is not written.
- Skirts can still pass through legs, and hair through arms.
- Toe tips are left out on models without toe bones.
- In a performer group, every performer uses the same model and mapping.

See the [README](https://github.com/antomarsi/miku-motion-blockbench-converter#readme) for the full guide.
